newsitem.title: UK: European raw cotton recovery continues.
newsitem.headline: European raw cotton recovery continues.

text.p: The post-holiday recovery in trading activity continued on Monday, as mills in Europe continue to look for supplies to meet outstanding requirements for autumn and winter shipment, industry sources said.
Business has often foundered on diverging price ideas however, and only the more sharply discounted of trade offers appear to have persuaded mill buyers to conclude purchases.
Competitively-priced central Asian cotton has remained the principal focus of mill demand in Europe.
